games.headline: Brunson, Towns and the bench help the Knicks beat the Bucks 117-85 for their fourth straight victory
games.desc: — Jalen Brunson scored 23 points, Karl-Anthony Towns had 21 points and 16 rebounds, and the New York Knicks beat the Milwaukee Bucks 117-85 on Tuesday night for their fourth straight victory.

games.headline: Jordan Goodwin scores 18 on 6 3-pointers, Suns ease past the Clippers 133-110
games.desc: — Jordan Goodwin scored 18 points in his return from a calf injury, Devin Booker added 17 and the Phoenix Suns cruised past the Los Angeles Clippers 133-110 on Tuesday night.

games.headline: Despite hurt wrist, Antetokounmpo scores 30 and Heat outlast Jazz 115-109
games.desc: — Giannis Antetokounmpo scored 30 points, Davion Mitchell added 19 points, and the Miami Heat outlasted the depleted Utah Jazz 115-109 on Tuesday night.

games.headline: Franz Wagner scores season-high 33 points as Magic beat Kings 107-100 to snap 4-game skid
games.desc: — Franz Wagner had a season-high 33 points with seven rebounds and seven assists, Anthony Black scored 26 and the Orlando Magic beat the Sacramento Kings 107-100 on Tuesday night to snap a four-game losing streak.

games.headline: Damian Lillard scores 25 points as the Trail Blazers beat the Thunder 123-103
games.desc: — Damian Lillard scored 25 points and the Portland Trail Blazers snapped a two-game skid with a 123-103 victory over the Oklahoma City Thunder on Tuesday night.
